en.title: Time and the Barber’s Craft — Sandun Barbershop
en.html:
Open film / availability ↗

Transcript

00:00:10 Convergent Journalism coursework

00:00:13 Along a street you can walk in five minutes,

00:00:15 stands a barbershop open for over half a century.

00:00:18 A photo studio, a tailor and a key-cutting shop.

00:00:22 Sandun Barbershop is the oldest in Sandun.

00:00:26 Passed down through generations,

00:00:27 its history adds up to a century.

00:00:30 Its present owners are Chen Liying and Sun Yiquan.

00:00:35 Sun Yiquan, 67, has cut hair in Sandun for over 53 years.

00:00:40 Chen Liying, 62, has been a barber for 43 years.

00:00:44 My name is Chen Liying.

00:00:46 This shop has been open for more than fifty years.

00:00:49 I have been doing this for over forty years.

00:00:51 I like this line of work.

00:00:52 Why?

00:00:53 I liked doing my own hair.

00:00:55 How could I do it? I thought, if I worked in a barbershop,

00:00:57 I could do it myself.

00:00:59 Both have reached retirement age,

00:01:02 but cannot leave their customers of several decades.

00:01:05 They decided to keep working,

00:01:08 until Sandun Old Street is redeveloped.

00:01:09 Until Sandun Old Street is redeveloped.

00:01:10 Older customers

00:01:11 like to have a shave,

00:01:13 so they come to us.

00:01:15 Other places do not offer shaving.

00:01:17 We do it for our longstanding customers,

00:01:19 who have come for decades.

00:01:21 We would not want a friend to come all this way for nothing.

00:01:24 For more than ten years,

00:01:25 a haircut has remained RMB 20.

00:01:28 We do not raise it. It stays the same all year.

00:01:31 That is the price.

00:01:33 When young people come for a haircut,

00:01:35 Ms Chen has her own thoughts.

00:01:38 What if they do not like it?

00:01:39 We tell them this is a place for older people.

00:01:42 If you want a younger style,

00:01:45 go somewhere else.

00:01:46 We tell them that directly.

00:01:49 I started cutting hair very young, at thirteen.

00:01:53 It was my grandmother

00:01:55 who told my mother—

00:01:56 there were many brothers in our family—

00:01:58 that learning a trade would put food on the table.

00:02:03 Grandmother said a trade would put food on the table.

00:02:04 But which trade?

00:02:06 My grandmother said,

00:02:07 generally,

00:02:08 carpentry

00:02:10 and bricklaying

00:02:11 require a three-year apprenticeship.

00:02:15 But barbering

00:02:17 needs only one year.

00:02:18 One year is enough.

00:02:19 A simple men’s haircut

00:02:21 can take Mr Sun over half an hour.

00:02:24 They come because we take care.

00:02:27 If you rush through it carelessly,

00:02:31 if you are that sloppy,

00:02:32 they will not come back.

00:02:33 4:38 p.m.

00:02:36 With the shop quiet, Ms Chen packs up and goes home.

00:02:40 At 4:44 p.m., Mr Sun finishes his final customer,

00:02:44 and chats with a visitor.

00:02:47 Then he clears away the day’s hair clippings,

00:02:51 washes the used towels,

00:02:52 and puts everything back inside.

字幕全文

00:00:10 融合新闻报道课程作业

00:00:13 5分钟就能走完的路上

00:00:15 开着超过半个世纪的理发店

00:00:18 照相馆、裁缝店、配锁店

00:00:22 三墩理发店是三墩最老的理发店

00:00:26 几代传承

00:00:27 前后加起来有百年时间

00:00:30 它现在的主人是陈立英和孙一铨

00:00:35 67岁的孙一铨在三墩理发已经超过53年

00:00:40 62岁的陈立英也已理发43年

00:00:44 我叫陈立英

00:00:46 这家店开了50多年

00:00:49 我是40多年了

00:00:51 喜欢这一行

00:00:52 为什么

00:00:53 就是我喜欢自己的头

00:00:55 怎么弄？我说我进了理发店

00:00:57 我可以自己搞嘞

00:00:59 二位都已经到了退休的年纪

00:01:02 但是放不下几十年的老顾客

00:01:05 两个人就决定继续做下去

00:01:08 直到三墩老街拆迁

00:01:10 上年纪的人

00:01:11 他们喜欢要刮胡子的

00:01:13 所以要到我们这边来的

00:01:15 外面不刮胡子的

00:01:17 就是为了自己的老顾客了

00:01:19 几十年的

00:01:21 万一那个朋友他跑过来白跑一趟

00:01:24 十几年来

00:01:25 一直保持着理发20元的规定

00:01:28 不涨的我们，反正一年四季都不涨

00:01:31 就是这个价格

00:01:33 对于年轻人来这里理发

00:01:35 陈师傅也有自己的想法

00:01:38 万一他们不喜欢呢

00:01:39 我们说我们这里是老年人啊

00:01:42 你们要剪得年轻点的

00:01:45 到外面去剪

00:01:46 我们就是跟他们直接这样说的

00:01:49 这个我开始理发很小的，13岁

00:01:53 是我外婆

00:01:55 跟我妈妈说

00:01:56 我们弟兄多

00:01:58 我外婆说学门手艺就有饭吃了

00:02:04 学什么手艺呢

00:02:06 我外婆说

00:02:07 一般来说

00:02:08 这个木工啊

00:02:10 泥工啊这些呢

00:02:11 要学三年学徒

00:02:15 那么这个理发呢

00:02:17 就是一年够了

00:02:19 简单的男发

00:02:20 简单的男士理发

00:02:21 孙师傅能理上半个多钟头

00:02:24 就是认真了他们才会来嘛

00:02:27 你敷衍潦草一下子就完了

00:02:31 你这么马虎

00:02:32 下次不过来了嘛

00:02:33 下午4：38分

00:02:36 看店里不忙的陈师傅收拾东西回家了

00:02:40 下午4：44，理完最后一位顾客的孙师傅

00:02:44 和来访者聊了会天

00:02:47 随后清理了一天理发留下来的垃圾

00:02:51 清洗用过的毛巾

00:02:52 将东西都收进屋子
